facts.business: Borosil Renewables Limited is India's first and largest solar glass manufacturer with a global footprint across the Americas, MENA region, and Europe, and has expanded into applications such as greenhouse glass, anti-glare glass, and Building-Integrated Photovoltaics (BIPV).
key_risks: Insolvency proceedings of subsidiaries GMB and Geosphere leading to deconsolidation and impairment of assets
Contingent liabilities including disputed tax demands and bank guarantees
